notes.title: How To Bathe Your Cat: Impossible Mission is here!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39634651/794753b39a4d74fbb6ebf378c59d4e7970d189e7.png[/img]

Bathing a cat is a difficult task, but sometimes it's necessary. Use drills, blowers, rockets and a grappling hook to destroy the ground and make the water reach the cat! Can you complete this hard mission? 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1867450/How_To_Bathe_Your_Cat_Impossible_Mission/

notes.title: How To Bathe Your Cat: Drawing is here!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39634651/a3f16b7d925174c837ba775fb2e1089e9651aae1.png[/img]

It is well known that cats aren' t really fond of water, but, as pet owners, we know that sometimes a good bath is welcome. Draw and use bombs to channel the water and clean your cat!

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
A new stage with eight levels, new achievements, new music and visual art has been added. The new levels have a 3D perspective that brings a new experience to the game.
